about: Desired setup of the studio X32 Rack, converted once from the Claude Doc 'Studio routing plan: X32 Rack and X-Touch' (rev 41, 22 Nov 2026), with the channel layout changed on 22 Nov: the most played sources, aux inputs included, on ch 1-16 through user routing. This file, not the doc, is now the source of truth for setup and drift checks (docs/x32-spec.md, 'Set up from the rig file'). Anything not listed here is left alone.

sources.name: King Rat
sources.notes: Return of the King Rat loop (fed by bus 1). On a channel so it has an insert point and a direct out.

sources.name: Koala
sources.notes: Scarlett 6i6 outputs: the iPad and Koala

sources.name: Mic
sources.phantom: check: only if the mic is a condenser

unused.notes: Their sockets now feed channels through user routing, so the aux strips are muted and unnamed, or those sources would be heard twice.

buses.name: King Rat
buses.notes: Aux outs run at +4 dBu, hotter than the King Rat expects: start sends low. Keep bus 1's send at zero on ch 4, the King Rat return.

buses.name: SP-404 Mk2
buses.notes: The SP-404's line inputs are unbalanced and may drop about 6 dB: raise the bus level if samples come in low. Turn input monitoring off on the SP-404. Pre-fader, so samples include the channel's inserts, EQ and dynamics.

buses.name: Koala
buses.notes: Into the Scarlett's inputs. Turn input monitoring off in Koala. Pre-fader, so samples include the channel's inserts, EQ and dynamics.

buses.name: P-6
buses.notes: Into the P-6's MIX IN. Aux outs run at +4 dBu, hotter than MIX IN expects: start sends low. Turn input monitoring off on the P-6. Pre-fader, so samples include the channel's inserts, EQ and dynamics.

fx.notes: Reverb, as a send effect. The effect type is left as it is on the desk for now.
Delay, as a send effect, synced by the tempo bridge once that's built. The effect type is left as it is on the desk for now.
Second delay or modulation. The effect type is left as it is on the desk for now.

card.notes: Each source records to Ableton as you hear it (post-fader), the effect returns in stereo, and the main mix as a reference. Card outs 21-22 are free for the spare channels 21-22 if they're used.

manual: Set each line-level synth's preamp gain low, and save it in the scenes (the app never sets gain).
Turn input monitoring off on the SP-404, in Koala and on the P-6.
In Ableton, keep track monitoring off, listen through the X32, and match the X32's sample rate.
Use scene safes to keep preamp gains and the monitor level out of scene changes.
